part.text:
Fix implemented and validated. The bug was in `runScripts` (internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/resource_provisioner.go:246): `comm.Disconnect()` was only triggered when the provisioner's whole-run context (`p.ctx`) was canceled, so SSH connections stayed established long after the commands finished. The fix builds a `cmdCtx` derived from the original context with its own `cancel` deferred until `runScripts` returns — disconnecting immediately after commands complete while still dropping the connection early on cancel.

Verification (via `docker exec` with `GOPROXY=off`, since the container lacks network for uncached test deps):
- `go test ./internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/` — ok (includes `TestProvisionerTimeout`, which asserts disconnect occurs after commands finish)
- `go test ./internal/communicator/ssh/` — ok (keepalive/disconnect tests still pass)
- `./internal/communicator/winrm` setup failure is a pre-existing missing-module-cache issue, unrelated to the change
